confidence.calibration_note: Raw softmax probability reflects relative logit dominance under training priors and is not temperature-calibrated physical certainty.

traversability.formula_summary: 0.45*terrain_composition + 0.20*big_rock_density + 0.15*sand_concentration + 0.15*segmentation_uncertainty + 0.05*region_fragmentation; overrides to insufficient_visual_evidence when valid pixels < 15% or mean_confidence < 0.50 or low_conf > 45%.
traversability.scientific_disclaimer: Experimental 2D semantic indicator ONLY. Visual terrain segmentation cannot verify physical traversability or rover safety without 3D stereo depth, slope, rock height, and wheel-soil mechanics.
